maps.points.mausoleum.detail-8: You step into a stone chamber barely large enough to stand shoulder to shoulder. The walls feel close, the air thick with must and intent.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue: Event opening (The mystery of the tombstone has been solved)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-10: The High Cleric raises his staff, icy energy swirling around him. From the staff's green crystal, a chilling mist seeps into your bones.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-11: The demon collapses into a heap of smoke and cinders. For a heartbeat it seems gone. Then its voice rises again, softer, coiled with reluctant respect.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-12: "Strong... stronger than most who dared call me. Very well. The circle holds, the blood binds. I am yours to command within these walls."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-13: The demon's silhouette takes shape once more. Bound by the ritual, Ixarion now follows your path, eager to hurl itself upon your enemies and tear them apart with claw and fang.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-14: As you approach the heavy stone doors, you notice faded sigils carved into the surface and streaks of dried blood. When one of you places a hand on the cold stone, a gruff voice calls out from behind the door, muffled but unmistakably human.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-15: "Hold. What is the password?" There's the sound of movement. Metal scraping, a blade being unsheathed. Someone is standing just on the other side, waiting.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-18: We are the flame beneath the ash.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-2: You step into a chamber disturbingly orderly compared to the rest of the mausoleum. A table covered in scrolls, a bed tucked against the wall, and a dusty library stand in eerie contrast to the surrounding decay.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-20: The blood of He Who Watches still feeds the roots.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-21: As you approach the heavy door, you find a set of massive stone doors etched with faded sigils and dried blood. When you place a hand on the cold surface, a gruff voice calls out from behind the door, slightly muffled but unmistakably human.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-23: A pause... then the voice responds flatly, almost amused: "...That'll do"
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-24: The stone doors groan open like something waking from a long, unpleasant dream. Inside, a circle of red-robed cultists stand silently around a dimly lit ritual hall. Their faces are obscured.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-25: They make no move to stop you. One of them gestures wordlessly inward. "Welcome, enlightened ones," one hisses with a bow too deep to be sincere.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-27: Laughter follows. Dry. Hollow. Cruel, echoing off the stone.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-28: "Fools. Did you truly think we'd let you walk among the blooded?"
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-29: "Your tongues lie better than your faces."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-3: The cleric in deep blue and crimson robes has his back turned, absorbed in his notes. When he finally notices you, shock flashes across his face.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-30: "Let's carve the truth from your bones."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-32: The voice hesitates. Then lowers in tone, almost in awe. "...You have seen the truth."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-33: The doors swing open immediately. The cultists inside bow slightly and part as the party passes.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-34: You step into a stone chamber barely large enough to stand shoulder to shoulder. The walls feel close, the air thick with must and intent.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-35: White candles burn in a circle. Their flames flicker, but the shadows do not.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-36: At the center: a pentagram, freshly drawn and still glistening. Inside the circle, a narrow pedestal stands. Upon it lies an open book, glowing faintly violet.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-37: "The balance here is wrong." (Party member required: Elk, Available once)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-38: "Old runes. Let me read their flow." (Party member required: Wizard, Available once)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-39: "A summoning circle. Hell's, maybe." (Party member required: Blood Mage, Available once)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-40: "Hang on. Checking for traps." (Party member required: Thief, Available once)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-42: You circle the altar, checking the seams, the base, even the cracks between stones. No wires, no pressure plates. Nothing mechanical.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-43: "Clean. If anyone dies touching this, it won't be because of traps."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-45: Your eyes narrow. The circle vibrates faintly. Not with absence, but with will. A demonic hunger. Definitely a summoning circle.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-46: Choose “Old runes. Let me read their flow.”
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-47: You trace the runes with care. The lines pulse faintly, as if refusing to die.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-48: "It's a binding circle. Infernal. Whoever drew this tried to summon something."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-5: The High Cleric reels in surprise. His icy aura collapses for a moment, leaving him vulnerable.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-50: You step closer, nostrils flaring. Beneath the scent of blood and stone lies something older, foul.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-51: "Never trust what crawls from hell," you say quietly. "It always comes hungry."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-52: The chamber greets you again with its heavy stillness. Wax has pooled on the floor in uneven shapes.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-53: Choose “No ritual this time.” (With Scroll of Binding)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-57: Choose “No ritual this time.” (Without Scroll of Binding)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-58: Choose “No ritual this time.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-6: Event opening (The tombstone riddle has not been solved yet)
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-60: You lean in, just beyond the pentagram's edge. The script twists. Jagged and unstable, it slowly settles into legibility. The words are old. Ritualistic.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-61: "He who completes the circle shall bind the One Below. Flesh and flame will obey, as long as the True Name is spoken. Should the name be unknown, the price shall be blood."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-62: Farther down the page, another passage burns softly in ink that never dried:
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-63: "The Bound may not stray far from the place of calling. Its leash is drawn in blood, and tied to stone."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-64: You search for the demon name. But it is not there. Whether hidden, erased, or never written.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-65: As eyes fall upon the page, the tome shivers. The letters flare bright, as though they *know* what you carry.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-66: The words burn scarlet: "Name it, and the chains will close. Call it, and flesh shall kneel."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-67: Red light spreads across the pages. The symbols rearrange themselves, responding to your knowledge of the demon's true name.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-7: The moment you step inside, the air grows heavy and cold. The chamber is unnervingly neat - a table of scrolls, a bed, a library of tomes. But all your attention is drawn to figure in deep blue and crimson robes, waiting for you.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-70: The tome lies open, but its presence is hollow. The ink looks faded, the once-living glyphs now nothing more than curling scratches.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-71: The magic that once fed these words is gone, bled out when the circle was destroyed. The book is just a book now.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-73: Your boot scuffs the chalk. The geometry collapses with a hiss, and a rush of stale air rolls across the chamber.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-74: The candles spit once and die down to weak embers. The book's pages hang limp, pale as old bone.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-75: The silence that follows is empty. Whatever force lingered here has ebbed away.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-77: Violet fire erupts from the circle. Smoke rises along the walls, and a horned figure emerges from the flames, its eyes glowing like hot coals.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-78: The demon's laugh is a jagged blade scraping the air.
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-79: "FOOOOLS. You summon what you cannot leash. You will bleed for my freedom, and I shall drink every drop."
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-8: "Did you truly think you could sneak into our sanctum?"
maps.points.mausoleum.dialogue-9: "Fools... the frost will claim your souls long before your bodies hit the ground."
